{{Top|leg}}
'''Solo Aerials''' were [[Swoopdueling/Legends|swoopdueling]] championship events organized on [[Jervo's World]] above [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]. Each combatant was armed with his choice of weapons and aerial vehicle. The vehicles were most often swoop bikes or speeder bikes but could also include jetpacks and even flying creatures. [[Goethar Kleej]] was the first warrior to win the Solo Aerials four consecutive times.
